analyzed_vuln.description: Heap-use-after-free is caused by the fuzzer harness itself in `fuzz_canvas`: it builds a `SkTextBlob` via `make_fuzz_textblob()` (case 51) and then later explicitly frees memory that belongs to that blob builder backing store (free at `FuzzCanvas.cpp:1569` in this build), while GPU text rendering still uses glyph/text data derived from that storage. The later draw path (`SkGlyphRunListPainter::drawGlyphRunAsBMPWithPathFallback` in `skia/src/core/SkGlyphRunPainter.cpp`) reads glyph metrics/IDs from the already-freed region, producing the UAF read.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In harness `api_mock_gpu_canvas`, fuzz input must drive `fuzz_canvas` through text/blob drawing commands so `make_fuzz_textblob()` allocates text/glyph buffers, then trigger the harness free path (line ~1569) before deferred GPU text processing completes. Because Ganesh/mock GPU execution can defer consumption of glyph run data, subsequent text draw processing in `GrTextBlob::generateFromGlyphRunList` / `SkGlyphRunListPainter` dereferences stale pointers, causing the ASan heap-use-after-free.
